exposure: Postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD) insertion during caesarean section
cohort: 200 women who gave informed consent for PPIUCD insertion during caesarean section from January 2013 to May 2014
finding: The study found that immediate intra-caesarean IUCD insertion appears to be a safe and effective method of contraception with high acceptability.
mod_finding: This study investigated PPIUCD insertion during cesarean section and found it to be a safe and effective method of contraception.
